lines.x: You want me to handle this basic work? That's really... hm? No offense taken. I just need to find a Little Helper first and learn how to do it.

The reconciliation was the Iberians' own achievement. The most useful thing I did was comfort angry people. Unfortunately, they fell asleep halfway through. But luckily, when they woke up they were so busy being angry at me that they completely forgot about taking revenge on the islanders. Only the Little Helper had a hard time repairing everything that got smashed.

It's only five o'clock. You can sleep a little longer before coming to work. Me? I was just organizing files. The archive threw an error just now, and I was worried... Are you worried I'm stealing secrets? Sigh. Little Helper, read through every file concerning the Doctor right now, then delete the records. Thank you.

A war-game sand table? Who does this stool-shaped piece represent? And the fin holding a gun? No, you don't really need to tell me. It just reminded me of a war game Aegirian children play, the kind that uses live slime molds as pieces. Turning life into game pieces so lightly... it still doesn't sit right in my hands.

What a long nameplate. Honorary Legion Commander, Honorary Consul, Honorary Chief War Architect... Heratia kept these titles for me only to remind me that I will never return to those posts. Just Clementia, all right? At least Clementia doesn't sound like the past tense.

Dr. Kal'tsit worries too much. I am not a proper Aegirian, or else from the moment I learned who you were, I would have racked my brains to dig into your memories. But all I thought back then was, "You really do have one nose and two eyes, how nice"... How nice, truly.

Don't hide it, Doctor. I am not Dr. Kal'tsit, and it isn't as though you don't know how harmful that stuff is. Who really gets addicted to these drugs? We're all just addicted to responsibility. Take it out. Your Sanity Potion, and my neuroactive agent... "Cheers"?

On my head fins... gloves? It was the Little Helper's idea, a randomly generated outfit plan. Clementia has decided too many matters of who stays and who goes, of merit and fault, of life and death. At least once in a while, when it comes to things like clothing, she wants to slack off a little too. Even if you think it doesn't suit me, don't say it, all right?

I'm truly friendly? Is that so. But whether toward Lord Carmen or toward the Little Helper, how is the smile I put on any different from the one I'm wearing now? Praising me like that at this point makes it sound as if I've never done anything special for you. Surely you can think of something else, can't you? Right?

Spending time with you like this and doing nothing at all, my fellow Aegirians would probably accuse me of monopolizing academic resources... No, never mind. You don't need to do anything. This is enough.

A pleasure to meet you, Doctor of Rhodes Island. The Little Helper I prepared for you has finished its encoding and can be printed out at any time. I hope the first thing we do together is to give it a name, as is the custom here. All right?
They all truly trust you.
Yes, I know. What I am doing now is still far from enough.
If it were Heratia, she would surely issue an evaluation report hundreds of pages long, declaring that I am unfit to stay here for long. But she can't take me away just yet, can she?
One last confirmation. You also believe it is necessary to resort to violence, yes?
You want me to decide whether these people live or die... Give me a reason.
Aegir is with you all, and I am with you all.
From now on there are only two outcomes: we achieve our objective, or we die fighting.
Doctor, report the battle situation.
Understood. I will carry it out.
All units, prepare to engage the enemy.
Hold formation, hold the line!
You had better have thought about why you resort to violence.
You should know full well why you are trembling.
Remember what you are dying for.
Whoever drove you to this dead end, I will find them, and I will deal with them.
This war will not end until their existence is utterly erased. Engineering units, clear the wreckage.
"Noble sacrifice"... All I see is innocent flesh and blood. Medical units, tally the casualties.
If only the name "Clementia" didn't mean "mercy." Mobile units, pursue and annihilate.
Finally, the more "important" one isn't me. You should go, Doctor.
If I stare at something for too long, please let me know. Everyone here seems quite used to preserving the traces of their lives, and I can't help being curious.
What do you need? A handshake, a hug, or... just a poke? Hm...
It's nothing, just a poke. Surely you haven't forgotten the understanding we reached before?
Arknights.

I'll have to trouble Rhodes Island to serve as witness to these negotiations. If there's no problem, please sign this... ah, one moment, let me print a new copy. The year on this one seems to have just expired. Rest assured, apart from the year, nothing will change. Wait for me, Doctor.
You stayed up all night again... It's fine, I didn't sleep either.

You're looking at Dr. Kal'tsit again. I understand that look in your eyes. Just as you feel relieved when something artificial gains true life, Aegirians can of course understand why one would celebrate a date determined by an incubation pod's calculations. Happy birthday, Doctor.

Would you close that so-called letter of congratulations? My path didn't turn out as Heratia wished, and she truly can't let it go. But that letter is just her clumsy attempt to express her feelings. Does it remind you of someone? I'm sorry. I hope the person you're thinking of won't be too harsh about the choices you make now.
